title: SOLEIL SHELLS
description: A resort concept of shell-shaped villas along a shore and over a lagoon, joined by a pier. Each two-level villa has a bedroom and lounge in the open front half facing the ocean, a bathroom in the deeper rear half, and a private terrace with a plunge pool. A submerged lounge sits behind transparent walls. At dusk the villas glow from within. A zoning diagram shows the layout.
role: Concept design, creative direction and visual storytelling - Mariia Andriiuk.
meta_description: Shell-shaped villas on a shore and lagoon, with a bedroom above the water and a bath lounge below. A resort concept of shell-shaped villas along a shore and over a lagoon, joined by a pier.
